name: Iron Mountain
where: Iron Mountain trails, Highway 67 at Poway Road, Poway, San Diego County
blurb: A busy, sunny trail from Highway 67 to the 2,696-foot summit of Iron Mountain east of Poway, with a quieter loop up the Ellie Lane Trail.
status: Open sunrise to sunset; the City of Poway closes the Iron Mountain trails on extreme-heat days (forecast 100°F or a heat advisory). No water and almost no shade.
